biofield: Your body is always working to heal itself.
It works through its tasks in order of priority.
Your Biofield Analysis reads those priorities, layer by layer.
The remedies under each layer were chosen to support that layer.
Together they make up your recommended program.
Dr. Glen puts it simply: "We don't treat. You treat yourself."
These findings describe your biofield and are not a medical diagnosis.
Consider starting with less and building up over a few days.
If you take any medicine, share this program with your prescriber.
As your body completes one task, your next analysis can show the next one.
diet: Food is the foundation of healing.
Much of what your body uses for repair comes from what you eat and drink.
Dr. Glen has written that Americans are "nature deficient, not drug deficient."
This report lists the foods to emphasize for you now, and the foods to avoid.
The foods to emphasize were chosen to support your body as it rebuilds.
The foods to avoid can add to what your body is working to clear.
You do not need to change everything at once.
Consider adding one food to emphasize this week, and setting aside one food to avoid.
You can notice how you feel before taking the next step.
If you follow a medical diet or have a food allergy, check each change with your doctor.
healing_tools: Your body runs on energy alongside chemistry.
Light and gentle electrical and magnetic fields are signals your cells respond to.
Dr. Glen teaches that small doses stimulate, so a short session can be enough to start.
Each tool in this report was chosen to support your body's own energy.
Many can be used at home as part of your daily routine.
Consider starting with one tool before adding another.
Follow each tool's own instructions for how long and how often to use it.
Ask your doctor first if you have a pacemaker or other implant, or if you are pregnant.
Never stare at a laser light source, or point it at the open eye.
These tools add to your medical care and never replace it.
ingredients: Your cells use nutrients and plant compounds to repair and protect themselves.
This report names the nutrients, botanicals and essential oils chosen for your needs now.
Many of them have been part of people's diets and traditions for generations.
Dr. Glen favors combinations of low doses over high doses of any one.
The form of a nutrient can matter as much as the dose.
This report can help you choose foods and products that supply these ingredients.
Start any new nutrient or botanical with a small amount.
Use essential oils only as their cautions direct.
Read the cautions that come with these ingredients, and share this list with your doctor.
remedy_sources: Where a remedy comes from matters.
Purity and form vary from one brand to another.
Dr. Glen has chosen these sources with ingredient quality in mind.
This report shows where to find each item listed for you.
Some items come directly from Healing Oasis.
Others you order from outside suppliers, some through Healing Oasis accounts and affiliate links.
Healing Oasis may earn a commission on some of those orders.
Items already in your Biofield Analysis program are marked.
Items not marked are for you to explore if you feel guided.
Consider asking the chat interface of Dr. Glen's knowledge-base if you are considering any of these.
